versions.content: Storage of Data Value Errors Count The RTE shall store number of data value error counter (errors due to invalid value or out of range errors) if the valueErrorCountEnabled for the port mapped to the signal is set to TRUE. The data value errors counter ( ValueErrorCount ) shall be returned as part of optional 413 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 parameter Rte_ComErrorInfo that can be returned from Rte API Calls (see chapter 5.5.7).
